items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: Tony Jackson. Tommy. Tommy. They first killed him and Tony's first killed. His sister's living here.

ctx.x: Tony Jackson. Tommy. Tommy. They first killed him and Tony's first killed. His sister's living here. Tony? Yeah. Still living? I think so. There's two sisters, aren't there? Oh. Tony's sisters, not Tommy. I thought you meant Tony Jackson.
No, this is Tony Jackson. Tommy is a cousin.
